understanding.goal_understanding: Place every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+' simultaneously; the level and game report WIN only when all goals are occupied.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces are selected by clicking their positions, then moved with directional actions or by clicking reachable grid positions. Walls and obstacles block movement, and pieces may be pushed when movement allows it; clicking an inaccessible or blocked location has no effect. Each action consumes a limited step, so movement and selection must be planned efficiently.
